title: Leakage precision, realized and awaiting integration
situation: The first leakage run over the whole design warned 69 times: none on concepts, 55 on decisions, 14 on examples, nearly all expected (realization decisions naming what they constrain; delivery's examples naming omp). Realized on feature/leakage-precision and accepted by both assayers: decide --kind meaning|realization, a classify verb recording a decision's kind as an entry of its own (a reclassification needs a reason), and a context subject's words exempting the plain word only, never a command, code span or flag containing it. A runtime older than this one refuses a journal that holds a classify entry.
decision: Leakage warns only where realization replaces meaning: a decision states whether it constrains realization, and one that does is not warned for naming what it constrains; the plain words a context's own subject names count as that context's own words.
consequences: On integration with the execution cut: install first, so the host's runtime knows classify; only then classify the realization decisions, accept this decision, and supersede implementation leakage and decision to carry the kind; then run leakage over the design again and read the remaining warnings.
